On this page

Models and Jev ​

The agent is built on pi, so every provider and model pi supports is available: log a provider in, or add a key, right here on the models page. The page holds three things: which model is the main one, Jev's key, and which provider search uses.

主模型: the main model ​

The model catalog comes from pi's agent directory (the built-ins, the pi.dev catalog, your own models.json) and is fetched at bot start and once a day after that, unless PI_OFFLINE=1; the 刷新目录 action in the page header fetches it again on demand. One chip shows the current main model and opens a searchable list. The main model must support vision: image understanding and sticker selection both rely on it. A model without vision stays listed and disabled with the reason. The 思考 select beside the chip picks the thinking level (off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max).

Jev（出口审查） ​

Jev is TypeSafe AI's decision model. It never writes replies; it answers yes/no questions with a probability: whether to join in, how long to wait before answering, whether to quote, which conversation goes first, whether a bubble may leave, whether a domain may be reached, which notes stay. Every outbound bubble passes it, so when it is unreachable the privacy check fails closed and not one message is sent.

This card shows its state (ok / missing / error) and the 设置 key / 更换 key button. The key is write-only, stored on the bot's side, and never returned to the browser.

The mode, threshold and extra criterion of each of its decisions live on their own pages: 回复时机 and 引用 on Conversations, 排队 on Advanced, 出口审查 on Safety. A new decision ships in 只记录不生效 - the log shows what it would have done before it is trusted with anything.

服务商: LLM login ​

Every provider pi registers, with the flows pi defines for it. Clicking one starts pi's own login; the browser only relays pi's prompts, stores nothing, can cancel mid-flow and can log out. Providers with no interactive flow are configured in the bot container's environment, as pi's own note says. Credentials are stored on the bot's side.

搜索服务商: search providers ​

Web search and page reading go through here, keys write-only as well. Which provider is active is picked in the card, exactly like the main model; with only one logged in there is nothing to pick and the bot uses it (the page says 未选用 and why). DeepSeek shares its key with the model login above: logging in on either side logs in both, and logging out does the same.
